title: Revival of 1946, solo piano and the Maritime Service
summary: He began solo piano around 1941-42, then served in the Maritime Service band 1943-45.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Well, of course that brought us up to pretty much up to the time of 1946 when all the revival of jazz came back. From there on, why it was really, I guess a story that everybody's been talking about now.
When did you start playing solo so much?

I started playing solo piano by 41 or 42 and then I was drafted in draft, not drafted, I enlisted in the U.S. Maritime Service and played with a little nine piece band all the two years of 1943, 44, and 45. I played with a nice little band. Had some fellas from Tommy Tucker's band. Billy Newboyga on drums. Nina Baconi on sax. Johnny Senac on bass.
